title: 5.2.20 Challenges: Optional Stretch
description: Add a second, harder-to-reach goal and track a two-goal completion count. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Run the one-goal scene
steps.instructions: The starter is the one-goal scene from 5.2.17: a canvas, a player, the ground and one gold goal with its single-fire check. Run it and touch the goal once to see the win line print in the console.
hints: Move with a and d, jump with the space bar while on the ground.

steps.title: Build a scene with two goals
steps.instructions: Add a second goal sprite somewhere harder to reach, then give it its own distance check in draw(), the same shape as the first goal's check.
hints: Copy the whole `if (goal) { ... }` block and change `goal` to the second goal's name everywhere inside the copy. Renaming the first one `goal1` and the new one `goal2` keeps them apart.

steps.title: Track how many goals are collected
steps.instructions: Use a counter (or check how many goal variables remain) to know when both goals are gone.
hints: content.md describes two acceptable ways to track this.

steps.title: Print the finish message once
steps.instructions: Print "All goals collected!" only after both goals are gone, and only once.
hints: Re-read 5.2.17 (Lab: Reaching the Goal) for the single-fire guard pattern.

requirements.title: Add a second goal sprite
requirements.description: A second goal sprite is created, so the scene has two goals as well as the player. Help: 5.1.6 (Sprite: new Sprite(x, y, w, h) + .color)

requirements.title: Give the second goal its own check
requirements.description: Each goal has its own distance check that deletes it, so the code calls .delete() for both goals. Help: 5.2.17 (Lab: Reaching the Goal)

requirements.title: Track collection progress
requirements.description: Your code knows when both goals are gone, either way content.md describes: a counter that goes up (or down) by one per goal and is then checked (collected === 2), or a check that both goal variables are gone (goal1 === null && goal2 === null, or !goal1 && !goal2). Help: 5.2.17 (Lab: Reaching the Goal)

requirements.title: Print the finish message
requirements.description: "All goals collected!" is printed from inside an if, once both goals are gone. Help: 5.2.17 (Lab: Reaching the Goal)
